results.title: Algerian Soldiers in Niger: European Union Seeks Clarifications - BENIN WEB TV
results.snippet:
A first Algerian military convoy has arrived in Arlit, northern Niger, Reuters reported on October 30, citing ten local sources. The number of soldiers and the timeline for their deployment have not been disclosed.
